title: Grr, Mondays: your real Monday as a grumpy doodle
summary: Post your honest, unglamorous Monday with "grr mondays" on it. AI redraws your photo as a scribbly, grumpy cartoon.
why: NapoleonCat's memes roundup, published November 1, 2026, lists #GrrMondays as an ongoing trend: people post their real, unflattering Monday with "grr mondays" on the image, and some redraw it as a cartoon. SocialBee's Instagram sounds roundup (October 7, 2026) says the matching audio is used on Reels about small annoyances and bad moods.
steps: Snap one honest photo of your Monday: the alarm, the cold coffee, the pile of laundry, your face at 7 a.m.
Attach it to ChatGPT or Gemini and paste the main prompt.
Post the doodle on its own, or as slide two after the real photo, with the hashtag in the caption.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Redraw the attached photo as a quick, grumpy hand-drawn doodle. Thick wobbly black marker lines on plain off-white paper, a few flat fills of muted colour, slightly messy on purpose, like it was drawn in 5 minutes on a sticky note. Keep the scene and the main objects from my photo so it's clearly the same moment. If a person is in it, keep them recognisable but cartoon them with a scowl and a little storm cloud over their head. Add the words "grr mondays" in big, uneven lowercase marker letters across the top. Square 1:1 image. No other text.

prompts.label: Variation: no photo
prompts.text: Draw a grumpy hand-drawn doodle of a typical Monday morning: [describe it, for example: a person in a toque scraping frost off a car windshield with a travel mug balanced on the roof]. Thick wobbly black marker lines on off-white paper, flat muted colours, a small storm cloud over their head. Big uneven lowercase marker letters across the top: "grr mondays". Square 1:1. No other text.

prompts.label: Variation: pets
prompts.text: Redraw the attached photo of my pet as a grumpy marker doodle on off-white paper. Keep their colours and markings so they're clearly the same animal. Give them a deep frown, half-closed eyes and a tiny storm cloud overhead, as if Monday personally offended them. Big uneven lowercase letters across the top: "grr mondays". Square 1:1. No other text.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Redraw the attached photo of our [type of business, for example: café counter] on a Monday morning as a friendly, grumpy marker doodle on off-white paper. Keep the layout and the products so regulars recognise the place. Draw the coffee machine with a little storm cloud over it. Big uneven lowercase letters across the top: "grr mondays", and smaller letters at the bottom: "we're open anyway". Square 1:1. No logos and no other text.

tips: The less glamorous the photo, the better. The trend is about honest Mondays, not pretty ones.
Post the real photo first and the doodle second, so people can compare.
If the letters come out misspelled, ask for the image with no text and add "grr mondays" in your editing app.
Only redraw friends or family who are happy to be in it.
